title: Function coverage for Write Single Coil
purpose: Provide a valid function 0x05 request using the documented legal ON value 0xFF00.
expected_behavior: Server should parse the request as Write Single Coil for address 0x0001 with legal ON encoding 0xFF00.
constraints_preserved: length is 0x0006 for unit_id plus 5-byte function 0x05 PDU.
Function code 0x05 is used for Write Single Coil.
Coil output value is the documented legal value 0xFF00.
issue_safety_notes: Uses a legal coil encoding and a small address to keep the seed valid and mutation-friendly.
